chunks: From him, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from a number of our companions, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The deceased is not shrouded in linen.

key_terms.قَالَ: he said, introducing the transmitted statement

ai.seo_question: Can a deceased person be shrouded in linen according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the shrouding of the deceased, stating that the dead person should not be shrouded in linen. It relates to the jurisprudence of funerary preparation and the proper treatment of the body after death.
